name: Python 3.12
updateContentCommand: if [ -f packages.txt ]; then sudo apt-get update && sudo xargs apt-get install -y < packages.txt; fi; if [ ! -x .venv/bin/python ] || ! .venv/bin/python -m pip --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then rm -rf .venv && python3 -m venv .venv; fi; .venv/bin/python -m ensurepip --upgrade; .venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip; .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
